context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 40 verified Quality Preset feature. Three presets available: draft (0 iterations, skips SERP+optimization, 1-2 min), standard (max 3 iterations, 3-5 min), premium (max 10 iterations, 5-10 min, default). Frontend shows 3 preset cards with data-testid='quality-preset-{draft|standard|premium}'. Premium is selected by default with purple border. Clicking cards changes selection. quality_preset field is passed in POST /api/articles/generate request. Draft preset skips both SurferSEO SERP analysis AND auto-optimization for fastest generation.
